rooms.introduction: Rooms now start as friends-only. Click here or the lobby gear to share invites, make your room public, and manage match groups.
rooms.visibilityHint: New rooms start as Friends only. Public rooms can be found by match code; match codes aren't passwords.
rooms.steamUnavailable: Steam room features are currently unavailable.
rooms.clientRoom: Only the host can change room settings. Player scaling syncs automatically.
rooms.closedRoom: The run has started. Room settings are locked.
rooms.codePlaceholder: Enter or paste a match code
rooms.invalidInvite: Invalid invite code or Steam room link.
rooms.duplicateCode: This match code is already used in another group.
rooms.openFailed: Room settings can't be opened on this screen.
rooms.operationFailed: Operation failed. Check your Steam connection and try again.
rooms.invalidGroup: Names can be up to 32 characters. Codes can be up to 128 characters / 256 UTF-8 bytes, with no control characters.
rooms.publishFailed: Match groups were saved, but the room could not be published. Set it to Public again and retry.
page.title: Settings
page.description: Play with up to 16 players, share Steam room invites, manage match groups, and adjust player scaling.
extraPlayerScalingMultiplier.label: Extra Player Scaling
extraPlayerScalingMultiplier.description: Only affects players beyond the fourth. Each extra player counts at this multiplier toward vanilla multiplayer scaling.
toast.incompatibleAccepted.title: Expansion limited
toast.incompatibleAccepted.body: Player {0} doesn't support the current Multiplayer Limit Break. The room stays capped at 4 while they remain.
toast.expansionBlocked.title: Cannot expand room
toast.expansionBlocked.body: The room already has incompatible players: {0}. {1} was rejected to prevent issues after expanding.
toast.protocolMismatchRejected.body: Player {0}'s Multiplayer Limit Break version isn't compatible with this room, so they were rejected.
toast.unsafeVanillaRosterRejected.title: Vanilla Client Join Rejected
toast.unsafeVanillaRosterRejected.body: Some players still require expanded-room support: {0}. {1}'s client cannot restore the lobby correctly, so their join was rejected.
toast.unsupportedRejected.title: Incompatible player rejected
toast.unsupportedRejected.body: Player {0} doesn't support the Multiplayer Limit Break features this room requires, so they were rejected.
toast.clientExistingBlockers.body: This room has incompatible players: {0}, so it can't go above 4 right now. The host rejected your join.
toast.clientProtocolMismatch.body: Your Multiplayer Limit Break version isn't compatible with this room. The host rejected your join.
toast.clientUnsafeVanillaRoster.body: Some players still require expanded-room support: {0}. Your client cannot restore the lobby correctly, so the host rejected your join.
toast.clientUnsupported.body: This room requires Multiplayer Limit Break support. The host rejected your join.
toast.clientRejected.title: Unable to join expanded room
toast.unsafeExpandedMessage.title: Unable to synchronize expanded room
toast.unsafeExpandedMessage.body: The room state received from the host was incomplete or invalid. Rejoin and make sure everyone has a compatible Multiplayer Limit Break version.
toast.expansionAvailable.title: Room can now expand
toast.expansionAvailable.body: Everyone in the room now supports Multiplayer Limit Break, so it can hold up to 16 players.
toast.vanillaAdmissionRestored.title: Vanilla Clients Can Join Again
toast.vanillaAdmissionRestored.body: The lobby is compatible with vanilla clients again. They can join while it has fewer than 4 players.
lobbyStatus.blocked: [Multiplayer Limit Break] Disabled by incompatible clients ({0}/{1})
lobbyStatus.availableTooltip: Multiplayer Limit Break expands the room when a compatible fifth player joins. The host and everyone in the room must support expansion.
lobbyStatus.blockedTooltip: Some clients in this room don't support the current Multiplayer Limit Break, so the room stays capped at 4. Affected players: {0}
lobbyStatus.activeTooltip: Expansion is active. Players joining this room also need a compatible version.
lobbyStatus.playerUnsupportedTooltip: This player doesn't support Multiplayer Limit Break, so the room stays capped at 4.
lobbyStatus.playerMismatchTooltip: This player's Multiplayer Limit Break version isn't compatible with this room, so the room stays capped at 4.
rooms.invitePlaceholder: Paste an invite code or Steam room link
rooms.matchCodeHint: Case-sensitive; leading or trailing spaces are ignored.
rooms.publishHint: Public rooms you host can be found with this code.
rooms.emptyGroups: Add a group to save a code you share with friends.
rooms.friendsHint: New rooms always start as Friends only. Invites don't bypass friend permissions.
rooms.publicHint: Non-friends can join by invite or link, or find the room through enabled match groups.
rooms.revealHint: Keep hidden while streaming to avoid exposing the code.
rooms.inviteHint: Enter on the join screen. Expires when the lobby closes.
rooms.linkHint: Works with vanilla clients too. Room capacity and compatibility requirements still apply.
rooms.manageGroupsHint: Save different codes for different friends, each with its own search and host switches.
rooms.scalingHint: Affects only players beyond the fourth. Default: 1.00×. Host changes sync to everyone in the room.
rooms.saveGroupsHint: Save to apply changes to match codes and search or host switches.
rooms.searchHint: Find public rooms using this code in the join list.
rooms.groupLabelHint: A local label; not used for matching.
rooms.copyMatchHint: Use the same code as your friends to find public rooms in your group.
